templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Thanks for your interest in Vida Motor. We'd love to help you find your perfect car.

Book a test drive today: https://vidamotor.co.uk/test-drive

The Vida Motor Team

templates.name: Follow-up
templates.subject: Following up on your enquiry
templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

I wanted to follow up on your recent enquiry. Have you had a chance to think about it?

Let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards
The Vida Motor Team

templates.name: Interested Lead
templates.subject: Great choice! {{customer_name}}
templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Great to hear you're interested! Let me arrange a convenient time for you to come in and see the car.

Best regards
The Vida Motor Team

templates.name: Not Interested Response
templates.subject: No problem, {{customer_name}}
templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

No problem at all. If you change your mind in the future, we'd be happy to help.

Best regards
The Vida Motor Team

knowledgeBase.title: Car Sales
knowledgeBase.content: We sell new and used cars from all major manufacturers.

knowledgeBase.title: MOT Testing
knowledgeBase.content: Full MOT testing service available. £45 for standard cars.

knowledgeBase.title: Car Servicing
knowledgeBase.content: Full servicing and maintenance for all vehicle makes.

knowledgeBase.title: Vehicle Finance
knowledgeBase.content: We offer competitive PCP and HP options through our finance partners.

knowledgeBase.title: Contact
knowledgeBase.content: Phone: 020 1234 5678, Email: hello@vidamotor.co.uk, Address: 123 High Street, London

knowledgeBase.title: New Car Deposits
knowledgeBase.content: Typically £500-£1000 deposit depending on vehicle price.

knowledgeBase.title: Used Car Pricing
knowledgeBase.content: Prices range from £5,000 to £50,000+ depending on age and mileage.

knowledgeBase.title: Returns Policy
knowledgeBase.content: 7-day cooling off period for new car orders. Used cars sold as seen.

knowledgeBase.title: Warranty
knowledgeBase.content: New cars come with 3-year manufacturer warranty. Extended warranty available.
